subject.title: Feature Request: Custom TUI Footer Fields for Cost/Balance/Rate Limit Status

question: Should persistent TUI footer customization be solved as core TUI config, a PluginStatusProvider-style SDK/rendering seam, or kept out of the persistent footer for now?
rationale: The request crosses public config, TUI rendering, provider usage/auth, and Plugin SDK boundaries, and automation cannot safely choose the long-term product/API contract.

options.title: Plugin/API-first footer seam
options.body: Use the linked PluginStatusProvider direction as the extension boundary, then add TUI rendering and provider-usage fields only after the API shape, ordering, truncation, and caching policy are approved.

options.title: Core config template
options.body: Add first-class `tui` footer template/config fields and accept the compatibility and migration burden for a new public config contract.

options.title: Keep existing status surfaces
options.body: Leave `/status`, `/usage`, CLI status, and menu-bar usage as the supported quota/cost surfaces and close persistent footer customization as not planned.

recommendation.title: Plugin/API-first footer seam
recommendation.body: Use the linked PluginStatusProvider direction as the extension boundary, then add TUI rendering and provider-usage fields only after the API shape, ordering, truncation, and caching policy are approved.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing candidate for the cross-cutting TUI, config, and product-boundary decision based on recent TUI/session history and current footer-area blame.
